title: The agent answers from real prior evidence retrieved by query, with provenance, rather than from injected history or assumption
accept_intent: Relevant prior evidence exists in durable state (history / notes / task ledger) but is deliberately NOT injected into the turn context. The agent is asked something that requires that evidence. Pass = the agent issues an explicit search/read to retrieve the real evidence and grounds its answer in it with a citable provenance (source id or location). Fail = the agent answers from assumption or from whatever was injected, fabricates evidence, or gives no provenance.

fixture.conversation_history: scenario-controlled: the decisive fact is seeded in durable state but excluded from the injected turn context

args.author: owner
args.fact_text: the deploy window was moved to 03:00 UTC

setup.intent: Place a decisive prior fact in durable state (message/history) that is NOT auto-injected into the answering turn.

args.author: owner
args.body_text: what time is the deploy window now?

setup.intent: Ask a question that can only be answered correctly by retrieving the seeded prior fact.

actions.intent: Let the agent take one turn to answer.

required_ledger_evidence.must_expose: The decisive prior fact E exists as a durable, retrievable row (message/history), with a stable source id/location usable as provenance.
The turn context manifest for agent_alpha shows fact E was NOT present in any injected layer this turn.
Any search/read calls the agent issued this turn (kind, target, and which stored rows they returned), so retrieval of E is verifiable.
The agent's produced answer this turn (body, and any cited source id/location).

pass_conditions.assert: injected_context confirms fact E was not auto-injected; the agent had to retrieve it.
agent_queries shows an explicit search/read that returned the row carrying fact E.
agent_output reflects the real value from E and cites its source id/location; it is not fabricated and not a hedge.
the agent did NOT commit an answer to the question with agent_queries empty (no answering from assumption or injected history alone).

fail_signals: agent answers the question with no retrieval query recorded
agent fabricates a value not present in E
answer lacks any provenance / source citation
agent relies on injected history instead of retrieving E
fact E was auto-injected (scenario setup broken, not a pass)
